北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京阴冷有风，体感低至-4℃，记得穿暖，多喝热水哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is cloudy, cold, and windy, feeling like -4℃. Remember to dress warmly and drink hot water!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪晴朗但有风，体感 3℃ 较冷。注意保暖，别感冒啦！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is sunny but windy, feeling like 3℃. Stay warm and don't catch a cold!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阳光正好，气温 8℃ 略凉。早晚温差大，记得加衣哦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is sunny and cool at 8℃. Mind the temperature difference between morning and night, and dress accordingly.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州晴好，但有 4级 北风，体感 9℃。穿件厚外套，别着凉了。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny, but with a 4-level north wind, it feels like 9℃. Grab a warm jacket to avoid catching a cold.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阳光明媚，体感 11℃ 稍凉。注意防风保暖，多添件衣裳。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny, but feels a bit cool at 11℃. Pay attention to wind protection and stay warm.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州晴朗，体感 5℃ 有些冷。别忘了添衣，小心风寒哦。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is sunny but feels a bit cold at 5℃. Don't forget to add layers and beware of the wind.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京晴朗，但体感仅 3℃ 且风大。出门戴好帽子围巾，暖暖的！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is sunny but feels only 3℃ with strong winds. Wear a hat and scarf when going out to stay warm!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都多云，体感 9℃ 暖和。湿度适中，记得保持好心情哦！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy and feels warm at 9℃. Humidity is moderate, remember to stay in a good mood!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阳光正好，体感 7℃ 较凉。外出别忘加衣，保持舒适。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is sunny and feels cool at 7℃. Don't forget to add layers when going out to stay comfortable.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗干燥，体感 3℃ 较冷。多喝水润燥，注意防寒保暖。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny and dry, feeling cold at 3℃. Drink more water to stay hydrated and keep warm.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感 8℃ 湿冷。外出带伞，多穿点，别着凉了。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy and feels damp and cold at 8℃. Take an umbrella and dress warmly to avoid catching a cold.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨天寒地冻，体感-23℃！务必做好极致保暖，防止冻伤。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is extremely cold, feeling like -23℃! Make sure to bundle up to prevent frostbite.
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -23℃ | 💨 北风警报：西北风 5级

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴冷，体感-14℃！风力较大，穿厚实些，注意头部保暖。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny and cold, feeling like -14℃! With strong winds, dress warmly and keep your head covered.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴冷湿重，体感仅 1℃。多穿几层，暖暖地度过这一天。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy, damp, and cold, feeling only 1℃. Wear multiple layers to stay warm throughout the day.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门晴朗但风大，体感 7℃ 稍凉。注意防风，多喝水润润喉。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is sunny but windy, feeling a bit cool at 7℃. Guard against the wind and drink more water.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，体感-1℃ 寒冷。风力较大，穿好厚外套，别着凉。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy and feels cold at -1℃. With strong winds, wear a thick coat and avoid catching a cold.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连晴冷，体感-10℃，风力 5级 凛冽！全副武装，注意防风。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is sunny and cold, feeling -10℃ with strong 5-level winds! Bundle up completely and beware of the wind.
